name: qlrisk_stress_test
title: Stress testing
description: Stress a book. mode='library' revalues it under qlrisk's historical crisis scenarios (1987_black_monday, 1998_ltcm_russia, 2008_gfc_lehman, 2010_euro_crisis, 2013_taper_tantrum, 2016_brexit, 2020_covid, 2022_rates_shock, 2023_regional_banks) or a chosen subset; mode='custom' under your scenarios, each a list of shocks (factor or curve twist / butterfly / parallel; the size field names its unit: size_bp for absolute rate, spread and dividend shocks, size_pct for relative and log shocks and absolute vol-point shocks, size for absolute price and FX spot shocks) or a stylised definition (equity_pct, vol_pct, credit_pct, commodity_pct, fx_usd_pct, fx_pct relative moves in percent; rates_bp absolute in basis points, or [short, long] for a 2y-10y twist); mode='reverse' finds the most plausible market move (minimum Mahalanobis distance) that loses target_loss. Returns P&L per scenario and per trade, worst first. Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, mode, scenarios, custom_scenarios, target_loss; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, history, lookback, top_n) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}, {"product": "EquityOption", "trade_id": "SPX-P", "maturity": "6M", "notional": 1000000, "ticker": "SPX", "strike": 5000, "option_type": "put", "counterparty_id": "BANK-B"}], "mode": "custom", "custom_scenarios": [{"name": "rates +100bp", "shocks": [{"risk_classes": ["IR"], "shape": "parallel", "size_bp": 100}]}, {"name": "SPX -20%", "shocks": [{"factor": "EQ.SPX", "shock_type": "relative", "size_pct": -20}]}, {"name": "risk off", "definition": {"equity_pct": -20, "vol_pct": 50, "credit_pct": 50, "rates_bp": -50}}]} gives 3 stress scenario(s); worst risk off P&L -87,108.25 USD on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
